book.title: Nzaelwapx-krbz Jiszs Mz Jon Da Kcng Tqyc-kapq-pnzng

content: Ninge Jon, kxnzawz ne Jiszs. Krlcng da kx naprtilzng kx aelwa-ngrm Jiszs bange. Rlr-ngrbz Gct mz Jiszs da lcng tqycpe pipz nzprtz-krmlr, mz nzvz-nqblq-krde me pnz drtwrde, murde na-aelwa-ngrbzle mz kxnzawz nedeng. X Jiszs atwzlr-ngrmle dq enjrl nede bange, murde nayokaetipxmle bange drtwr ngr da lcdeng.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, sc tqyropex da amrlx kcng tqmcxng x tqxlrxng. Krlcng natq Gct x nrpa angidr ngr Jiszs Kxnzmcpx.
Namrlzbz mz doa kx rlwxpxle natq lcng tqyrox mz buk lc. X namrlz-kzpz mz leplz kcng tzxlrlr x tzyrlq-angidrlr natq lcng. Murde sa nakrlz-angidrlr da lcng amrlx mzli kc tqycpe pipz nzprtz-krmlr.
Jon Ryrbz Mz Dzbe Lrmakxtr Mz Taon Rlimz Mz Esia Provins

Ninge Jon, ryrbo bamu nimu dzbe lrmakxtr kcng mz taon rlimz mz Esia Provins. Krka'-ngrne kx zmrlzkxmyalz x nzmnc-zpwxngr na-avzom Gct, Mqngrkxtr x Jiszs Kxnzmcpx bamu. Gct kc tqmnc mzli ka, x tqmnc zvz, x sa navzm. X Mqngrkxtr kc tqmnc mz tron kc tqwxbungr Gct x nzwz-krdeng kcng rlimz. X Jiszs Kxnzmcpx kc tqrpipx angidr natq Gct, x doa kx nzatulz-kaip mz nzbzngr, a' trpengr nzbz-krde. X nide kc tqaclvele king amrlx mz nrlc tulvzo. Jiszs Kxnzmcpx lc mrlzti-zvzle nigu, x aopxpebzle drtqgu mz zmatq ngr alwx rgung mz nzbzo-krmle mz kros.

X ata-lxblrtrle nigu mz dzbede kc esz', murde nawztrpzku mz Gct Trtede, kc tqngi King rgu, mz nzngini-krgu pris nedeng. Takitrde nzglqlz-zvzngr nide mz nzetukr zmatq ngrde, kc tqvzpe tqvzpe. Eu, angida.

Jiszs sa navzom natuom mz dcbz. X sa namc leplz amrlx ngr nrlc tulvzo, nidr badr leplz kcng tzrbatrpzng nzrluplxtingr nrkrdrtq Jiszs mzli kc. X leplz amrlx mz nrlc sa namwxlrng x nayrni-zlwzng. Me tutr-ngrde lape! Eu, angida.
Rpi Yawe kx, “Ninge Gct kc tqrninr, kc tqmnc mzli ka, x tqmnc zvz, x sa navzm. Ninge nou da amrlx x kx ayrkrpx da amrlx.”
Jiszs Kxnzmcpx Opx Mz Mz Jon Apule Mrlx Leplz

Ninge Jon, x prtrku mz dzbede kc esz' mz nztu-amqngi-krgu kxmule-esz' nzaetqbz drtqgu murde mnclzbzku mz Jiszs mz nzngini-krde King rgu. Nzadwatrlr ninge presin mz trmctu Patmos, murde yapwxtipx-zvzx natq Gct x Nrpa ngr Jiszs.
Mz kzdq Sade mrlc, zmatq ngr Mqngrkxtr prsrle ninge, x obq-rmwiblex. Mzli lcdepwz xlrkixle mz nibrnge kzdq natq Kraes kxetu apule nzyrnikr trpu.
Rpile kx, “Yro mz buk da amrlx mcqng, x atwzlr-ngrbz buk lcde mz Esia Provins mz dzbe lrmakxtr mz taon rlimz seleng: Efiszs, Simrnz, Prgamzm, Taeatira, Sadis, Filadelfia x Laodisea.”
Kx lxlvrkimc kc mq mz nzmc-krnge kc tqycmnem bange, mcx da rlimz kx ngi gol kxwxbuo-ngrm lam.
X mz mzlirdr, kzdq ncblo, kx apule Mrlx Leplz, kq nzkq kxboi, x lunyao-ngrde kc da kx apule gol.
Nqngi narde prkitxpx apule nqbya ngr nrc. X mzte nzapulr nalzpq nyr.
X nanycde kz nzapulr nzpnaprkr bras kc tzayrleni mz nyr x sc tzalqtipe. X nzokr natqde apule nzyrpukr nrc.
X malele mz mqde kxrtc vri rlimz, x lvcpxm mz naode kc toki r vea kxmalc nrlarde rlilr, x nzyzlrkr rtrlrmzte apule nzlulikr nepi mzli kc bea.
Kx mcx kc nide, rtco-lzbq-ngrbo mz nanycde apux ncblo kx bz, mz nzangio-krnge nide. A' mqde kxrtc bxtrple ninge x rpimle bange kx, “Bzkq mwxlrq. Ninge kx rtwayz x ninge kx rmnr-ngrbz.
Ninge nou nzlungr. Bzx mzli kc ena, a' nzlupe-mou-krmc lc mzli ka tqvzpe tqvzpe. Lolvzx zmatq ngr nzrlvxngr x nzrbqtrngr naonrx ngr mrnyz mqngr leplz kxnzbzpeng.
Yro da kcng tqmcqng, tqprtilzng mzli ka, x da kcng naprtilzng mz nibrde.

Drtwr ngr vri lcng rlimz tqmalex mz mqnge kxrtc x da rlimz kx ngi gol kxwxbuo-ngrm lam nidr sele. Vri kcng rlimz drtwr ngrdr kxnzaclvelr dzbe lrmakxtr mz taon kcng rlimz, x da rlimz kx ngi gol kxwxbuo-ngrm lam, drtwr ngrdr dzbe lrmakxtr mz taon lcng rlimz.”
